subject: Scheduling: Medilink case study discovery interview
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medilink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling: Medilink case study discovery interview

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for agreeing to talk with us about Medilink's integration with Redwood. We'd like to run a short discovery interview to capture the business impact and technical details for a written case study and a brief customer spotlight video.

High-level ask: 30–45 minute conversation with your product/technical stakeholder and someone who can speak to outcomes (e.g., Head of Ops or Product). We'll record the session for note-taking and will share a consent form and draft before publishing.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Feb 19, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Feb 19, 14:00–14:45
- Fri Feb 20, 09:30–10:15 (shorter 30 min option)

If none of those work, send a couple of times that do. Also helpful to know who will join from your side (names/titles) and if Legal needs to sign anything in advance — we can send a short release for signature.

I've attached a brief draft list of interview questions and a copy of our standard consent form for your legal team to review.

Thanks — appreciate it!

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
